caption: Sophos Endpoint Detection Atributes
description: Sophos specific detection attributes for endpoint-based detections.
name: sophos_endpoint_detection

insights.description: Interesting facts about source process, e.g. Unsigned, Suspicious_Execution_Path, Persistence_Context.

context_summary.description: Interesting facts about source process execution context, e.g. viaAutoStart, viaDllSideload.

detection_type.description: The type of the detection, or detector, e.g. Behavioral, VDL, HMPA, AMSI.

indicator_type.description: The type of threat indicator that triggered the detection, e.g. LOLBIN, Low_Rep, Recently_Written.

threat_type.description: The type of the detector, e.g. Malware, PUA, App.
